name: Regenerative Hull

automation.text: You touch a vehicle. At the start of each of your turns, the vehicle regains a number of Hit Points equal to twice your spellcasting modifier. A vehicle must have 1 HP or more to be affected.

subclasses: Occultist Monster Hunter, Sanguine Thief Rogue, Spellslinger Gunslinger, Arcane Hand Monk, Arcane Hand Monk
